description: Unique identifier for this model coverage record.

Canadian province/territory code the model is tied to; the only record of a model's provinces/territories, and drives the catalogue filter and map. Record sub-regions, ecosystems and US states in region_detail.
Sub-region within the jurisdiction; a specific area; an ecosystem or ecoregion; or a US state to which the model also applies. Leave blank for province-wide coverage.
Stand conditions the model is applied to in this jurisdiction.
